pages.name: Mavka
pages.text: A spirit that keeps to the Mavka Trees. She lets no one close without reason.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: $(li)$(#A33B3B)Poisonous touch:$() her blow poisons you.$(li)Attacks hostile creatures, the Chuhaister and the Zlydeny.$(li)Leaves peaceful animals, hukhas, bisyks and skarbnyks alone.$(li)There are three at a Mavka Tree and ten at a Titan Tree.

pages.title: What to do
pages.text: $(#2E7D4F)Become a friend:$() help them defeat the Chuhaister, their sworn enemy. Details in $(l:general/affection)“Favour of Creatures”$(/l).$(br2)They like $(item)Wither Roses$(). But strike a Mavka and the friendship is gone.
